name: Photo Mechanic
price: Photo Mechanic: $14.99/month, $149/year, or $299 perpetual (1 year updates); 30-day free trial. Photo Mechanic Plus (catalog tier, $24.99/mo, $249/yr, $399 perpetual) is discontinued for new buyers since 27 Feb 2026, though the store page still lists it.
current_version: 2026.6 (build 9175), latest announced on the Camera Bits blog
engine: Images: embedded RAW JPEG previews, optional Apple ImageIO/Adobe DNG Converter rendering; video playback macOS only, engine not documented
summary: Photo Mechanic is a fast ingest, culling and metadata tool for working photographers, especially press, sports and wedding shooters. It opens folders and memory cards directly, shows RAW files instantly from their embedded previews, and excels at captions, IPTC metadata, keywording, batch renaming and uploading on deadline.
where_it_wins: Ingest from multiple memory cards at once, with renaming and metadata during copy
IPTC/XMP metadata, code replacements, variables and structured keywords for captioning on deadline
Star ratings, colour classes and tags to cull thousands of RAW files quickly
Batch rename, Save As/resize/watermark and direct upload to FTP, Dropbox, S3, PhotoShelter and more
Regular-expression find and replace across filenames and metadata
Fully customizable shortcuts with presets, and printable shortcut PDFs
Windows version with the same feature set
where_schnellbild_wins: Free with every feature; Photo Mechanic costs $149/year or $299
No license activation or periodic online check; runs in the App Sandbox without network
Plays MKV, WebM, WMV and more through the built-in VLC engine; Photo Mechanic plays MOV/MP4/MPEG/AVI and only on macOS
Video skimming with arrow keys, subtitles, audio tracks, playback speed
Archives and comics (ZIP, RAR, 7z, CBZ, CBR) open like folders
Slideshow through all subfolders with photos and videos mixed
List view, folder tiles with previews, dual pane with F5/F6
Interface in 20 languages; Photo Mechanic is English only
Boss key, open source, build attestation

free.note: Subscription $14.99/month or $149/year, or perpetual $299 (1 year of updates); 30-day trial

native_apple_silicon.note: Universal binary since the current (non-PM6) builds; PM6/PM Plus legacy builds are Intel-only

no_account_no_tracking.note: No ads, but a license key must be activated and the app goes online periodically to validate the license

dark_light_setting.note: Light or Dark theme setting on macOS covers messages and dialog boxes; preview background colour is separately settable

languages_20.note: Docs and downloads show only English; no statement on UI localisation found (Spanish forum board exists)

folder_browsing.note: Opens any folder as a Contact Sheet, no import needed

thumbnail_grid.note: Contact Sheet thumbnail grid; folders appear in a Navigator tree, not as preview tiles

list_view.note: View menu (full list) has contact sheet views, filters and cursor modes; no column list view

recursive_search.note: 'Open Folder and Subfolders' puts a whole tree in one Contact Sheet, then Find searches names/IPTC; Spotlight-based 'Search my Mac' on macOS

regex_search.note: Find and Find & Replace support Grep regular expressions

network_shares_fast.note: Built for speed ('world's fastest photo browser'); Navigator/Favorites threaded so slow network volumes don't block; I/O is the bottleneck

multiple_windows.note: File > New Window (macOS) plus Contact Sheet tabs

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/HEIF, WebP; AVIF and JPEG XL read-only since 2026.6 build 9175

img_raw.note: Shows the JPEG embedded in RAW files for speed; optional full RAW rendering via Apple ImageIO or Adobe DNG Converter

img_psd_exr.note: PSD (saved with maximum compatibility) yes; OpenEXR not in the supported formats list

img_svg_pdf.note: Neither SVG nor PDF is in the supported formats list (unknown files only as proxy placeholders)

img_animated.note: GIF listed as supported format; animation playback not documented

keyboard_paging.note: Arrow keys in Preview window and slide show

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom and pan in Preview; rotating writes the EXIF orientation flag (it is not view-only)

slideshow.note: Image > Slide Show (Cmd-L) with transitions, captions, shuffle, loop

slideshow_recursive.note: Possible after opening 'Folder and Subfolders' in one Contact Sheet; slide show docs only describe images, so videos in the show are unconfirmed

auto_enhance_view.note: Preview offers shadow/highlight clipping toggles and histogram, but no auto enhance or adjustment view

file_info_exif.note: Info panel with customizable EXIF/IPTC variables, histogram; codec/bitrate details for videos not documented

wrong_extension_note.note: Not documented; View menu only offers "Unknown files as proxies"

video_native.note: MOV, MP4, MPEG playback on macOS only (Windows: thumbnails/preview need GStreamer)

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: AVI listed; MKV, WebM, WMV, FLV are not in the supported formats list

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Videos appear in the Contact Sheet next to photos

video_skim_arrows.note: In the Preview window ← / → move to the previous/next item

subtitles_embedded.note: No subtitle command in the full shortcut list or preview toolbar description

subtitles_external_files.note: No subtitle command in the full shortcut list or preview toolbar description

audio_track_choice.note: Not in the full shortcut list or preview toolbar description

playback_speed.note: Not in the full shortcut list or preview toolbar description

control_bar_movable.note: Docs only mention a video progress bar in the preview window

playlist.note: No playlist; slide show runs over the selection/contact sheet

saved_playlists.note: Slide show settings can be saved as a Snapshot, but not item lists

pip.note: Not in the full shortcut list or preview toolbar description

music_mode.note: Only plays WAV voice notes attached to photos (Play/Stop Sound File)

online_subtitles.note: No subtitle support in the shortcut list or preview toolbar

video_filters_enhance.note: Preview toolbar: navigate, rotate, IPTC, external editor, copy, delete, 2-up, color management; no video adjustments. Video playback macOS only

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: No Quick Look/Finder extension mentioned in docs or downloads

manga_two_page.note: 2-up view exists for comparing photos, not a reading mode

rename_trash.note: Rename single/batch, delete to Trash (preference), new folders in the Navigator

move_copy.note: Drag thumbnails onto folders (Option copies); Copy/Move tool to multiple destinations

dual_pane.note: 2-up Preview compares photos; no two file panes with copy/move keys

undo_file_actions.note: Edit > Undo/Redo on macOS 'when available'; which file actions are undoable is not specified

image_editing.note: Crop, rotate, resize and watermark on Save As/export; no pixel editing (sends to external editors)

batch_convert.note: Batch rename, Save As (format/resize), metadata, watermark

library_catalog.note: Tags, star ratings, colour classes, IPTC keywords stored in files/XMP; the catalog database (Photo Mechanic Plus) is no longer sold since 27 Feb 2026

cloud_sync.note: Upload to FTP/SFTP, Dropbox, Box, Amazon S3, Flickr, SmugMug, PhotoShelter, Zenfolio and more; web galleries; email

keyboard_first.note: Built for keyboard culling: single-key rating/tagging, shortcuts for nearly every function

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Keyboard shortcut PDFs for macOS and Windows on the downloads page

app_sandbox.note: Not in the Mac App Store; entitlements not checkable without installing

no_network.note: Periodic license validation; uploaders, reverse geocoding, software update checks

notarized_attested.note: Proprietary paid app (EULA on the download page), so no build from public source; notarization not checkable

mac_app_store.note: Not found in the Mac App Store; sold via camerabits.com
